reason: The PR is framed as a broad type/package relocation refactor: moving metadata structs like `XXInfo`/`Job` out of `parser/model` into `meta`, with very wide cross-repo touch points (`br`, `lightning`, `ddl`, `executor`, etc.). From the metadata alone, this does not look centered on planner, executor runtime behavior, expression semantics, session behavior, KV/store correctness, privilege enforcement, or parser SQL semantics; the target-module edits are more likely import/type migration fallout than core behavioral changes.
